queries.sql:
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT * 
FROM projects 
WHERE projects.id = $1::UUID) AS anon_1, EXISTS (SELECT * 
FROM plants 
WHERE plants.id = $2::UUID) AS anon_2

WITH touch_project AS 
(UPDATE projects SET updated_at=$8::TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE WHERE projects.id = $9::UUID RETURNING projects.id)
 INSERT INTO projectplants (project_id, plant_id, notes, quantity, unit, optimum_height_size, rate) VALUES ($1::UUID, $2::UUID, $3::VARCHAR, $4::FLOAT, $5::VARCHAR, $6::VARCHAR, $7::FLOAT) ON CONFLICT (project_id, plant_id) DO UPDATE SET notes = excluded.notes, quantity = excluded.quantity, unit = excluded.unit, optimum_height_size = excluded.optimum_height_size, rate = excluded.rate RETURNING projectplants.project_id, projectplants.plant_id, projectplants.notes, projectplants.quantity, projectplants.unit, projectplants.optimum_height_size, projectplants.rate
